bands.name: Struggling
bands.brings: A running fountain and lifted shutters

bands.name: Recovering
bands.brings: Lit lamps, open kiosks and visitors

bands.name: Lively
bands.brings: Stall lanterns, visitors and fine goods

bands.name: Thriving
bands.brings: A travelling stall and a full square

store.greet: Buy things for your homestead here. Tomorrow the shelf has different ones.
store.shut: Pip’s shelf is empty for now. It fills up again when the square is in better shape.
sold: {item} is yours. I had nearly named it.
There goes {item}. The shelf looks surprised.
A fine choice: {item}. I was saving it for nobody.
store.title: Pip’s General Store
store.inShed: It is in your homestead shed.
store.byVan: It comes to your homestead by van.

board.title: Square Report
board.intro: Every player shares this square, and things in it break. Walk up to a broken thing to fix it; every fix helps everyone.
board.omen: A cursed night is coming: crows on every bench, and a ghost out in daylight.
board.night: It’s a cursed night. Stay near the lit lamps. Cursed things you find are yours, and the night stall buys them.
board.after: Last night’s curse left dark lamps, shut doors and litter. Help fix them today.

merchant.name: Fine Goods
merchant.greet: Rare things from far away. They cost a few more coins than Pip’s.
lines: {item} has crossed several cobbles to meet you.
A costly piece, but worth every coin.
{item} is wrapped up. The wrapping is complimentary.
That one does not visit Pip’s shelf.
Coins well spent. The stall approves.

vendor.name: Night Trading
vendor.greet: I buy the cursed things you find, and I sell a few of my own.
vendor.bought: {item} is back where it can misbehave politely.
lines: {item} prefers the dark, but it will manage indoors.
A small trade for a long night.
Take {item}. Leave the moonlight where it is.
That piece has been waiting beside the monument.
The lanterns do not mind a little competition.

ghosts: The bench remembers me better than I do.
The dry fountain made a very convincing swimming pool.
I used to admire that statue. It never returned the effort.
One lamp blinked at me all evening. I blinked back.
These cobbles were warmer when I had feet.
The bench has a wobble. It is doing its best.

cafe: The Coffee Cup is Bean’s coffee kiosk and is shut today. Fix the stuck coffee machine to open the door again.
The Coffee Cup is Bean’s coffee kiosk and is shut today. Fix the loose propeller bolt to open the door again.
The Coffee Cup is Bean’s coffee kiosk and is shut today. Fix the split water hose to open the door again.
info: The info point is Dot’s map kiosk and is shut today. Fix the cracked map glass to open it again.
The info point is Dot’s map kiosk and is shut today. Fix the scattered leaflets to open it again.
The info point is Dot’s map kiosk and is shut today. Fix the dead inside light to open it again.
store: The general store is Pip’s shop and is shut today. Fix the jammed cash register to open it again.
The general store is Pip’s shop and is shut today. Fix the fallen shelf to open it again.
The general store is Pip’s shop and is shut today. Fix the blocked cellar hatch to open it again.

lowShut: This shop is shut because the town is run down. Fix broken things in the square and it opens again.
This shop is shut with the rest of the square. Fix broken things outside and it opens again.
This shop cannot open while the square is broken. Fix things in the square and it opens again.

work.crate: A heavy crate: you walk slower while you carry it.
work.stocked: There it is: a full shelf, ready for the customers.
work.full: Every shelf is full. Nothing more to stock today.
work.moved: You chose {where}; your old place will manage.
work.already: You already have a spot here.
work.busy: You already work at {where}. Ask to stop there first: one job at a time.
work.quitDone: Of course. Your rank here waits for you if you come back.
work.keep: I can only take you on once your pass is saved. Save it, then ask me again.

start.stand: Tap the lemonade stand, then Go to work. Customers come to you.
start.cafe: Tap the Coffee Cup, then Go to work. Customers come to you.
start.condo: Inside the arcade: sweep up litter and fix dark cabinets.
start.store: Inside Pip’s store: fill shelves from the crates and serve the customers.
start.post: Tap the post office, then Go to work to sort the post.

work.paidHere: Payday: {coins} coins for last week’s work, paid into your pass.

locks.store: Pip’s General Store will have the last one of everything.
locks.post: The post office will send letters and postcards beyond the square.
locks.cafe: The Coffee Cup will be a café where you can work a shift.
locks.story: Your town story opens this fence. There is more to do first.

rooms.condo: Spinner’s Arcade. Tap a cabinet to play for prizes to wear, or ask Spinner for a job.
rooms.store: Pip’s general store: homestead things for sale at the counter. Ask Pip for a job here.

objects.name: Humming Waylight
objects.desc: The lantern hums so loudly that nearby cobbles vibrate, even with its switch off.

objects.name: Winter Campfire
objects.desc: Blue flames leap from the fire, but they freeze the air instead of warming it.

objects.name: Homeward Teddy
objects.desc: The teddy bear spins itself to face the north road whenever anyone turns it away.

objects.name: Unclaimed Rucksack
objects.desc: The rucksack refills itself whenever it is emptied, though no banana owns it.

objects.name: Everbloom Urn
objects.desc: White flowers burst back into bloom the instant one wilts, though nobody put them in the urn.

objects.name: Blinking Redcaps
objects.desc: Every mushroom cap flashes on and off like a tiny lamp that has swallowed a storm.

objects.name: Wandering Tinwalker
objects.desc: The wind-up robot marches to a different cobble whenever anyone looks away.

objects.name: Absent Reflection
objects.desc: The mirror reflects the whole square but erases the banana standing directly in front of it.

objects.name: Lost-Hour Clock
objects.desc: Its hands point to twenty-five o’clock and chime the impossible hour for the empty square.

objects.name: Lasting Camp Lamp
objects.desc: The camp lantern hums and stays blazing inside a closed crate with no air or switch.

fx.yours: Your firework bursts over the square.
fx.named: {name} sends a firework over the square.

toasts.lure: Lures only work when you fish at the beach pier. Nothing to do with one here.
toasts.asleep: This cabinet is not answering. Try again in a moment.
toasts.prize: You won {prizes}. It is in your wardrobe now.
toasts.haunt: Tonight is haunted: bolder ghosts, and a cursed thing to find.
